name: Build

on: [pull_request]

jobs:
  commontasks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Avoid 0x0BDA
        #Find devices that not use 0x0BDA instead of const USB_VENDOR_ID_REALTEK
        run: grep -c -i "0x0BDA" os_dep/linux/usb_intf.c | grep -w 1
      - name: Find duplicates
        #Find devices that not use 0x0BDA instead of const USB_VENDOR_ID_REALTEK
        run: grep -i "{USB_DEVICE(" os_dep/linux/usb_intf.c | cut -d ')' -f1 | sort | uniq -cd | wc -c | grep -w 0
      - name: Get kernel matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          JSON=$(curl -s https://www.kernel.org/releases.json)
          VERSIONSARRAY=$(echo $JSON | jq -c '[.releases[] | {version: .version, moniker: .moniker} | select(.moniker != "linux-next") | .version]')
          echo ::set-output name=matrix::${VERSIONSARRAY}
  build:
    needs: commontasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        kernel_version: ${{fromJson(needs.commontasks.outputs.matrix)}}
        # kernel_version: [6.1-rc1]
    steps:
      - name: Download kernel packages
        run: |
          KERNEL_URL=https://kernel.ubuntu.com/~kernel-ppa/mainline/
          KERNEL_URL_DETAILS=$(wget --quiet -O - ${KERNEL_URL}v${{matrix.kernel_version}}/ | grep -A8 "Build for amd64\|Test amd64")
          ALL_DEB=$(echo "$KERNEL_URL_DETAILS" |  grep -m1 'all.deb' | cut -d '"' -f 2)
          AMD64_DEB=$(echo "$KERNEL_URL_DETAILS" | grep -m1 "amd64.deb" | cut -d '"' -f 2)
          [  -z "$ALL_DEB" ] && exit 1
          [  -z "$AMD64_DEB" ] && exit 2
          wget -nv ${KERNEL_URL}v${{matrix.kernel_version}}/$AMD64_DEB
          wget -nv ${KERNEL_URL}v${{matrix.kernel_version}}/$ALL_DEB
          echo "KVER=$(echo $ALL_DEB | cut -d '_' -f 2 | rev | cut -c14- | rev)-generic" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      - name: install deb packages
        run: sudo dpkg --force-all -i *.deb
      - name: update GCC
        run: |
          sudo update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/gcc gcc /usr/bin/gcc-14 14
          sudo update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/g++ g++ /usr/bin/g++-14 14
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: build kernel ${{ matrix.kernel_version }}
        run: make KVER=$KVER CC=cc

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
